benchmark_type_evidence: We introduce INDICIFEVAL, a benchmark evaluating constrained generation of LLMs across 14 Indic languages using automatically verifiable, rule-based instructions. It comprises around 800 human-verified examples per language spread across two complementary subsets: INDICIFEVAL-TRANS, translated prompts from IFEval (Zhou et al., 2023) carefully localized for Indic contexts, and INDICIFEVAL-GROUND, synthetically generated instructions grounded in native Indic content.
brief_description: IndicIFEval is a benchmark for evaluating verifiable instruction-following in 14 Indic languages, comprising two subsets: IndicIFEval-Trans (translated and localized from English IFEval) and IndicIFEval-Ground (synthetically generated instructions grounded in native Indic content from the Sangraha corpus), with ~800 human-verified examples per language.
